_comment: F1 — the FAQ collection document type driving /national-show/faq (F4).
A collection, not an array on the singleton, because the committee will add and confirm
questions one at a time and each needs its own confirmation status.
name: showFaq
title: Show FAQ

fields.name: answer
fields.title: Answer
fields.description: Reuses the existing portableText object type — same as nationalShow.exhibitorStages, so it renders with the <PortableText> component already used on /national-show.

fields.name: category
fields.title: Category
fields._comment: The four categories named in spec §4.17 plus General as the honest home for anything that fits none of them.

fields.name: order
fields.title: Order
fields.description: Sort position within the category. Lower first.

fields.name: status
fields.title: Confirmation Status

list.title: Pending — placeholder answer, committee must supply
Research — our own verified research, not committee-confirmed
Confirmed — signed off by the show committee

fields._comment: Identical three-value list to confirmationStatuses. Per-document because FAQs get confirmed individually.

fields.name: active
fields.title: Show on the site
fields.description: Uncheck to hide a question without deleting it. Same pattern as Ticket Types.

query.name: showFaqsQuery
query.groq: *[_type == "showFaq" && active == true] | order(category asc, order asc, question asc){ _id, question, answer, category, order, status }
query._comment: Sorted server-side. The tertiary sort on question makes rendering deterministic when two entries share an order value — otherwise the page HTML changes between requests and the ordering assertion flakes.

categoryOrderOnPage._comment: Category display order is a PRESENTATION decision, not editor content — it is a fixed constant in the page/component, and it is the ONLY hardcoded list permitted by this contract. It contains no venue-derived value.
categoryOrderOnPage.rule: A category with zero active FAQs renders no heading at all. An unknown category value coming back from Sanity is appended under General rather than dropped — never silently discard editor content.
